calibration.reason: No calibration fit has been performed yet.

rejected_datasets.reason: Turbofan. Brayton cycle, spools at 10,000-50,000 rpm, degradation by blade fouling. It contains no per-cylinder channels at all - and per-cylinder asymmetry is the entire diagnostic basis of piston-engine condition monitoring.
Bearings, batteries, IGBTs, milling. No piston engine data.
Rolling-element bearing vibration only - a component, not an engine.
No provenance. The question 'which engine?' has no answer.
Classified. Will not be released. The architecture is built to accept it without code change.

limitations.title: Real data is from a Cessna 172, not a MALE UAV
limitations.detail: Same engine class: 4-cylinder horizontally opposed, ~180 hp, air-cooled, fuel-injected. The thermodynamics, failure modes and sensor channels transfer. Duty cycle and airframe do not.
limitations.mitigation: Domain gap stated explicitly and quantified; feature layer is engine-configurable.

limitations.title: Vibration and injection timing have no real data
limitations.detail: Two of the required channels are generated by the physics model.
limitations.mitigation: Tagged SIMULATED in the UI, in the API payload and in every export. The boundary is never blurred.

limitations.title: No operational validation on DRDO / VRDE engine data
limitations.detail: Operational validation on a VRDE engine is outside the current prototype scope.
limitations.mitigation: Validated against NGAFID-MC labelled maintenance events and the published benchmark task.

limitations.title: The physics model is a simplification
limitations.detail: JSBSim FGPiston is a validated open thermodynamic model but it is not a crank-angle-resolved CFD simulation.
limitations.mitigation: Model-vs-data divergence is reported on the Validation page rather than hidden.

limitations.title: The published RUL benchmark is coarse
limitations.detail: The NGAFID benchmark task is P(RUL > 2 days), a binary serviceability question.
limitations.mitigation: Reported as published. No continuous hours-remaining curve is invented.

limitations.title: 'Real-time' means near-real-time on replayed flights
limitations.detail: The physics model runs faster than 1 Hz so lockstep is genuinely achievable, but the demonstration uses replayed flights, not a live aircraft.
limitations.mitigation: Live aircraft demonstration is declared out of scope.

limitations.title: No CAN bus hardware
limitations.detail: The SocketCAN interface is implemented and demonstrable over the vcan0 virtual device.
limitations.mitigation: The code path is real; only the wire is virtual.

limitations.title: Single engine type in the corpus
limitations.detail: Generalisation across engine families is unproven.
limitations.mitigation: Feature layer is engine-configurable; reported as a limitation on generalisation.

out_of_scope.item: Onboard edge deployment on real hardware
out_of_scope.why: No hardware budget; category is software
out_of_scope.presented_as: Edge / GCS split is shown in the architecture

out_of_scope.why: No user need for a ground control station
Defence data does not go to public cloud
out_of_scope.presented_as: Deliberately rejected - on-premise is a requirement

deployment_phases.title: Open-data validation
deployment_phases.detail: NGAFID-MC replay, residual loop, benchmark reproduction.

deployment_phases.title: Test-rig validation
deployment_phases.detail: Same data contract against DRDO / VRDE test-rig instrumentation.

deployment_phases.title: Classified-data retraining
deployment_phases.detail: Retrain in place at VRDE. No application code change required.

deployment_phases.title: Hardware-in-the-loop
deployment_phases.detail: Physical CAN bus, engine controller in loop, edge residual path.

deployment_phases.title: Operational evaluation
deployment_phases.detail: Ground control station integration and flight-line trial.

transfers.detail: Valve distress, head cracking, detonation, bearing wear
Dependence on airspeed, altitude and ambient temperature

does_not_transfer.detail: A MALE sortie is far longer than a training flight
Pusher-propeller induced flow at the engine bay

domain_gap.statement: Operational validation on DRDO / VRDE engine data is outside the current prototype scope.
